title: A New Era
body: Inspect other players, report bugs from inside the game, and a new pendant to hunt. Rings and pendants are rebalanced, and Noria's meadows turn gold. The first time you log in, a few slides show what's new.
changes: What's New: slides on your first login after an update
Inspect: see another player's gear, figure and stats from the player menu
Report a bug from the button on the minimap
Pendant of Haste: a powered pendant for attack speed
Jewel of Chaos drops from every monster level 12 and up
Hold the left mouse button to keep walking toward the pointer
Rings and pendants rebalanced: Fire and Poison weaker, Fury stronger
Legendary rings and pendants show orange, and their cards say what each line does
Noria's meadows get golden and amber grass; Lorencia's grass fits its slopes
Low-end PCs start on lighter settings with Direct3D 11
Party and guild speech bubbles are cleaner
Inventory drag and drop: items overlapping, dropped behind windows, or landing off the pointer
No sound when another player levels up

title: The Golden Dragon arrives
body: Gather your friends: the Golden Dragon raid is open. This patch also fixes a crash some players had on NVIDIA RTX cards.
changes: Crash on start on NVIDIA RTX cards
The launcher updates itself and the game

title: The launcher is here
body: One small launcher for Windows and macOS installs the game, keeps it up to date and picks graphics settings for your PC.
changes: First Mac install stopping part way

title: Guilds and the market
body: Found a guild, wear its mark, and trade at the Broker in three cities. Aida opens with all six of its monsters.
